environment_and_model_stat_identity.cache_regime: fresh worker, OS page cache uncontrolled, no purge

metric_scope.decode: primary delivered streaming metric: sum(n-1 tokens including final EOS) / sum((n-1)/runtime decode_tokens_per_second); includes callback/journal work between first and last token
metric_scope.forward_only_decode_tps: sum(n-1 tokens) / sum(token_seconds[1:]); excludes first token and between-step callbacks, includes synchronous correctness instrumentation
metric_scope.reported_stream_decode: original runtime field retained separately; its end-minus-first interval includes callback work
metric_scope.end_to_end: all generated token IDs including EOS / parent supervisor elapsed; includes process startup/imports and supervision
metric_scope.worker_wall: worker interval starts after imports; includes tokenizer/model initialization and task execution
metric_scope.parent_minus_worker: startup/import/supervision/teardown difference; not a pure import timing
metric_scope.ttft: runtime first synchronized token interval; excludes process imports and model initialization
metric_scope.memory: owned RSS sampled by parent and MLX allocator peak are distinct overlapping measures, never added
metric_scope.swap: system-wide observed changes; other applications may contribute
metric_scope.physical_reads: process OS-accounted storage read bytes; unknown remains null; not certified NAND/SSD bandwidth
metric_scope.expert_load_times: per-expert load times absent; aggregate packed-read and read/dequant counters retained separately
metric_scope.exactness: per-token logits/routes hashes, token IDs and positions; full KV/recurrent payload equality was not captured here
metric_scope.provenance: recorded before/after source/protocol/model identities for measurement interval; current checkouts and weights not read
metric_scope.statistics: six descriptive paired observations over three prompts; IQR uses linear quantiles; no population/thermal/general quality guarantee

limitations: Model stat identity is frozen; this harness did not recalculate the complete model-file hash.
Fresh workers do not establish cold physical SSD or controlled OS page-cache state.
Complete Qwen checkpoint execution on these prompts is not a general quality certification.
No GLM-5.3, competitor performance, sustained thermal or external SSD promotion follows.
